description: This file defines interfaces for managing reftable structures, including function declarations for initializing iterators and blocks, and referencing external structures and functions related to reftables, blocks, and iterators.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a reftable table as a string.

methods.name: table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for a reftable table with a specified type.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a reftable block by reading data from the table at a specific offset.
